categories.main_business_segments: Fujian Cosunter Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. operates primarily in pharmaceutical manufacturing with three main business segments: (1) Generic antiviral drugs for hepatitis B treatment, including nucleoside/nucleotide reverse transcriptase inhibitors; (2) Liver protection and hepatic health products, particularly silymarin-based formulations; (3) Innovative drug development and commercialization, including antiviral, anti-cancer, and anti-fibrotic therapies. The company also produces cardiovascular drugs, male health products, and other pharmaceutical formulations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced pharmaceutical manufacturing technologies including GMP-compliant production facilities, solid oral dosage form manufacturing (tablets, capsules, granules), and specialized formulation techniques such as self-emulsifying drug delivery systems. Core competencies include nucleoside/nucleotide drug synthesis, quality control systems, and clinical research capabilities. The company operates multiple production bases with state-of-the-art equipment and has established integrated raw material and finished product manufacturing capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include hospitals, pharmaceutical distributors, retail pharmacies, and government procurement agencies across China. Key end markets are chronic hepatitis B treatment, liver disease management, cardiovascular disease prevention, and male sexual dysfunction treatment. The company serves both urban and rural healthcare markets through multiple distribution channels, with significant presence in government-organized centralized drug procurement programs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with regional divisions covering: Eastern Region (Shanghai, Anhui, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Fujian), Southern Region (Guangdong, Guangxi, Hainan, Hunan, Hubei), Northern Region (Heilongjiang, Jilin, Liaoning, Inner Mongolia, Beijing, Tianjin, Hebei, Shandong), Northwest Region (Xinjiang, Ningxia, Gansu, Qinghai, Shaanxi, Shanxi, Henan), and Southwest Region (Sichuan, Chongqing, Guizhou, Yunnan, Tibet). Headquarters are in Fuzhou with manufacturing facilities in Zherong County, Ningde.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: upstream in raw material and active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) production through subsidiary Jintang Pharmaceutical; midstream in formulation and manufacturing; and downstream in distribution and sales through direct sales teams, distributors, and government procurement channels. The company maintains integrated production capabilities from API synthesis to finished pharmaceutical products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus is on innovative drug development with emphasis on: (1) antiviral therapies including hepatitis B clinical cure through multi-target combination therapy (GST-HG131, GST-HG141, GST-HG121); (2) anti-cancer and anti-fibrotic agents targeting liver disease (GST-HG161 targeting c-Met); (3) non-alcoholic fatty liver disease treatment (GST-HG151); (4) COVID-19 antivirals (GST-HG171/Taizhodin, approved 2023). R&D investment represents 74.33% of 2023 revenue, demonstrating commitment to innovation-driven growth.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through three primary channels: (1) Direct sales (66.85% of 2023 revenue) through company-employed sales teams providing academic promotion and terminal management; (2) Distributor/dealer model (10.21% of revenue) where distributors purchase products for resale; (3) Government centralized procurement (20.72% of revenue) through national and provincial drug procurement programs with volume-based pricing. Additional revenue comes from technical service contracts and property leasing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Cosunter is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer of hepatitis B antiviral drugs, being one of the few Chinese companies with all five major nucleoside/nucleotide antivirals (adefovir, lamivudine, entecavir, tenofovir, TAF). The company competes with both domestic generic manufacturers and international pharmaceutical companies. Its competitive advantages include comprehensive product portfolio, established distribution networks, GMP-certified manufacturing, and emerging innovative drug pipeline. The company is transitioning from generic drug focus toward innovative drug development.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company generated operating revenue of 422.7 million yuan (9.58% growth from 385.8 million in 2022) but reported a net loss of 348.6 million yuan (compared to 127.4 million loss in 2022). Total assets reached 1.614 billion yuan. The company is in a growth investment phase with significant R&D expenditure (132.96 million yuan in 2023) offsetting profitability. Cash flow from operations was negative at -174.6 million yuan, reflecting heavy investment in innovation drug development and clinical trials.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Cosunter's value proposition centers on: (1) comprehensive hepatitis B treatment portfolio offering patients multiple therapeutic options with proven efficacy and safety; (2) innovative drug development addressing unmet medical needs in hepatitis B clinical cure, liver cancer, and liver fibrosis; (3) quality assurance through GMP-compliant manufacturing and rigorous quality control; (4) accessibility through government procurement participation ensuring affordability; (5) first-mover advantage in innovative antivirals like Taizhodin with superior safety profile (lowest daily dosage among marketed COVID-19 treatments) and efficacy against XBB variants. The company emphasizes scientific solutions for liver health as its core mission.
